scenario_policy.baseline: Every UAT starts from a fresh fixed fixture baseline; UAT branches never accumulate mutations from another UAT.
scenario_policy.state_units: All numeric state fields are integer CNY cents. null means not applicable, not zero and not omitted.
scenario_policy.command_binding: Each stage binds frozen named envelopes in command-samples.json or explicitly declares a procedural operation. Semantic inputs are oracle setup, never API DTOs.
scenario_policy.labor_history: Confirmed: new-accounting-month labour uses monthly pool/group rounding; OPEN-20260831 legacy balances remain opening coverage and are not rebuilt into new monthly groups.
scenario_policy.cost_scope: company_cost_cents includes entire confirmed salary pool; allocations only redistribute cost; project_cost_cents separately reported for labor stages.
scenario_policy.forecast: remaining_forecast_magnitude_cents is a scenario-direction magnitude, not signed company forecast or bank balance. Inflow UAT03/08/10/11/12/14; outflow UAT06/07/17/18; null means unconfigured. Cash is cumulative within scenario.
scenario_policy.oracle: Every stage state is a future expected snapshot at fixed_context.as_of, organization ENT-A, CNY, effective adjustments included; no query/product result was executed. Null ETC means no approved remaining-cost estimate.
scenario_policy.pipeline: Seed facts are explicitly approved setup records; draft.save samples require future submit and independent approval before post/recognize. dry_run=false denotes intended future authenticated browser/service execution, never personal AI authorization.
scenario_policy.cash_opening: net_cash_movement_cents excludes brought-forward bank balance. UAT12 carries separate declared opening100000 and expected account150000 after new receipt50000. Other scenario bank movements must not be presented as full bank balances.
